business.description: Genus Paper & Boards Limited manufactures premium quality packaging paper from recovered as well as virgin fiber through sustainable processes, equipped with five state-of-the-art paper machines. Key products are Kraft Paper, Duplex Board and other specialty papers catering to FMCG, Pharmaceutical, Consumer Durable Products and E-commerce sectors.

outlook.statement: The India paper and paperboard packaging market size is expected to grow from USD 13.72 billion in 2025 to USD 14.54 billion in 2026 and is forecast to reach USD 19.57 billion by 2031 at a 6.13% CAGR over 2026-2031. Paper consumption in India will likely reach 30 million tonnes by March 2027. About 50% of global paper demand is in Asia, out of which India is the fastest growing market expected to grow at about 4% to 5% compound till at least 2030. Consumption of paper and board in India is expected to grow to over 35 million tons by 2035 from approximately 22 million tons presently.
Some of the factors that could affect the Company's performance could be the demand and supply for Company's product and services, changes in government regulations, tax laws, forex volatility, etc.

The paper and packaging industry in India has emerged as a key driver of innovation and value creation across manufacturing sectors, particularly in FMCG, agriculture, and food processing. Packaging now ranks as the fifth-largest sector of the Indian economy, expanding rapidly at 22-25% annually.
India's paper, paperboard and newsprint trade remained strong, with imports reaching 2,552.80 thousand tonnes and exports standing at 1,536.50 thousand tonnes across major grades.
Strong export performance of value-added paper grades and sustained import demand for specialised paper products highlight the sector's expanding integration with global markets.
